From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Mutual roadmap & approval lane — sprint to pilot (stakeholders & dates)

Hi Maya — thanks again for taking the time today. I wanted to capture the key points and proposed milestones while they're fresh. Please skim and flag anything I've missed or misstated.

What I heard from the call:
- Pain: current latency and cost on generation endpoints is blocking a wider rollout of the customer-facing agent.
- Primary goal: reduce per-call cost by ~40% and hit 250ms p95 latency for short-chat workflows by end of Q4.
- Constraints: security audit window in October; procurement prefers a single-vendor proof-of-concept (POC) with clear acceptance criteria.

Proposed mutual roadmap (high-level):
1) Week of Sep 13 — Technical POC: scoped set of three endpoints, baseline perf metrics collected. (Owners: Novus eng lead, Jordan)
2) Sep 27 — Budget & procurement check: procurement confirmation of pricing band and SOW terms. (Owners: Novus procurement, Ben)
3) Oct 11 — Security evidence handoff: SOC2 excerpts, network diagrams, and runtime isolation docs. (Owners: Novus security reviewer, Karthik)
4) Oct 25 — Pilot run: 2-week pilot with traffic redirect and monitoring. Acceptance = performance + no blocker security findings.
5) Nov 8 — Exec review & decision to commit or extend.

Stakeholders I have on the thread for operations and procurement are Ben (pricing/terms) and Karthik (security/compliance). If there's an internal Novus person who should be on the procurement thread, please add them.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can you confirm the security audit window dates (you mentioned early October)?
- Who will own procurement sign-off on your side (name & email)?
- Do the acceptance criteria above match your expectations?

Attachments: I attached a one-page proposed MPA spreadsheet with milestones and a short checklist for acceptance criteria. I also included a list of standard security artifacts we can provide.

Thanks — I can send a calendar card for the Sep 13 tech POC if that helps.

Best,
Jordan

- Procurement owner: I'm looping in Priya Rao (procurement lead) at procurement@novusai.com — she will own contract review and SOW.
- Acceptance criteria: the performance targets look right. For the pilot we also need a data-retention statement documenting what logs are kept and for how long.

I'll review the attached MPA with the engineering lead and get back with any redlines by Monday 9/6. Can you provision a sandbox token for the POC ahead of Sep 13?

- POC period: 2 weeks; estimated committed capacity small (single modest GPU pool).
- Price guidance: we'll share a pilot quote and an A-B pricing band for production commit once we finalize scope.
- Security artifacts: SOC2 excerpts, runtime isolation overview, and sample audit logs (we can redact customer data). Karthik is copied for any technical security follow-ups.

Next steps for procurement:
1) Priya — can you confirm preferred contract timeline and whether Novus needs a standard PO or SOW first?
2) Ben — I'll need the pilot quote and standard pilot SOW draft; can you push those by Tuesday 9/7?

Thanks — happy to jump on a 20-min call with procurement if helpful.
